evidence: app/package.json:14 — Angular 22.2, the current stable release, nothing newer
app/src/app/app.config.ts:5-14 — only provideBrowserGlobalErrorListeners, provideHttpClient, provideRouter: all stable, CLI-default providers
grep of app/ for unstable_/experimental_/provideExperimental — zero matches
reach.rationale: The app rests entirely on APIs that have been stable for multiple release cycles (v17–v20); it uses none of v22's newly stabilized or developer-preview features despite being on v22.2.

evidence: app/src/app/core/api.service.ts:14-47 — all HTTP access funneled through one Injectable, trivially swappable
app/src/app/app.config.ts:1-15 — the only framework-level configuration in the app, four lines of stable providers
containment.rationale: There is nothing experimental to contain; even the pieces most likely to churn (HTTP, base URL, caching) are isolated behind a single ApiService.

evidence: app/src/app/pages/home-page.ts:111-125 — native form elements with plain event handlers instead of adopting newly-stable Signal Forms
app/src/app/core/catalog.service.ts:31-44 — RxJS shareReplay for in-memory caching, per the spec's allowance
app/src/app/pages/pokemon-page.ts:319-328 — effects used only for title/scroll side effects, the documented use case
justification.rationale: No experimental APIs are used at all, so none are gratuitous; every choice (signals for view state, RxJS for request coordination) matches the framework's own current guidance.

findings.issue: @angular/forms is declared as a dependency but never imported anywhere in src/
findings.suggestion: Remove the unused @angular/forms dependency to keep the install lean

findings.issue: Effect with setTimeout for #moves fragment scrolling is a hand-rolled workaround around router scroll behavior; not experimental, but it's the only place reaching outside idiomatic APIs
findings.suggestion: Consider withInMemoryScrolling/anchorScrolling router features instead of a manual scroll effect

summary: This is a conservative, entirely long-stable Angular 22.2 codebase: signals, signal inputs, toSignal, effect, control-flow blocks and standalone bootstrap, all stable since v17–v20 and confirmed against the v20/v22 release notes. It deliberately skips even the recently-stabilized v22 features (Signal Forms, async signals) in favor of plain form elements and RxJS+toSignal. Zero experimental or preview APIs; the only nit is an unused @angular/forms dependency.
